description:
Fetch a rendered Framesail image so you (and your user) can SEE it —
    pass a URL from get_segment_assets, get_style, or asset endpoints. Returns
    the image inline. Only Framesail media URLs are allowed.

url.description: Public Framesail media URL to fetch — a public_url from get_segment_assets, a file_path from list_assets, or a template/preset image URL from get_style / list_style_presets; other hosts are rejected
url.title: Url
